requirement.value: Captain (Commander) or Blackguard (Darkblade) mastery + Charging Cavalry and Shadow Strike

system.description: When you use the Shadow Strike Skill, you may treat your High Roll as being equal to 0 when determining damage dealt by this attack. If you do, after the effects granted by Shadow Strike are resolved, you may immediately perform the Charging Cavalry Skill for free (paying the appropriate MP cost).
